work.title: Readela 0.3.0: the popup as the owner approved it — aligned rows, a palette that follows Appearance, Help, and each message beside what it is about
work.ownerAuthorization: Owner instruction of 2026-10-13 to implement the popup design the owner approved, from the design package the owner supplied (a preview page, pictures of its states, and its wording), with the owner's amendments in that instruction: the order Appearance, Direction, Font, Text size, Line spacing, Bookmark; the visible name Direction with the accessible name Text direction; Save place as the first bookmark action; the corrected sentence "Save your place in this conversation."; a footer of Reset settings, By Amir42 and the version only; bookmark messages under the bookmark's buttons and settings messages with the reading settings; the total and the shortcuts as secondary information under the actions. It authorizes commits and their plain push without a check after each step, local test builds and the evidence the repository's workflow requires. It does not authorize a change of the typography, of how reading settings or bookmarks work or are stored, of permissions, of the supported sites or of the version number; a new feature; merging pull request 9, marking it ready, a tag, a release, a store submission or a change to Personal OS.
work.relationToDecisions: DEC-143 says the first bookmark action is Save and that the popup shows the combined total only. The instruction is the owner's later word on both: the action reads Save place, and a line under the buttons says what holds for this conversation. Recording that as a Decision is the owner's to do in Personal OS and is named in the handoff; it is due before the Integration Gate, not before this work.

parentPreflight.reason: That assertion covered a correction of spacing in which no control was added, removed or hidden, and is not edited. This is a separately bounded piece of work: the popup's layout, wording and palette change.

designReference.what: The owner's design package final-design.rar, kept outside the repository: preferred.html and its pictures, readela-final-review.html, final-ux-copy.md and .json, render-checks.json.
designReference.use: Appearance and wording only. The preview's own script, which imitates the extension, is not used; the popup keeps its code and its contracts with the page and with storage.

inScope: This record, committed first on the existing branch from baseCommit.

src/ui/popup.html, src/ui/popup.css and src/ui/popup.js: each reading setting as a row, its name at the start and its choices at the end; the order and the names of the instruction; a selected choice shown by its fill, its border and its weight, at the size of the others; the popup's colours following Appearance (Original: the browser's light or dark scheme; Paper; Night), from the palettes the popup and the reading themes already have, with no setting of its own; Help, closed until opened, with the approved text; the bookmark as a row with its messages under its buttons and the total and shortcuts under those; a place for what a change of settings or Reset has to say, with the reading settings; a footer of three things; the approved wording, with the corrected sentence.
src/browser/shortcut.js only for the names the popup shows beside the keys.
Unit and end-to-end tests for what changes, and a look at the rendered popup in Chrome and Firefox.
Documentation and dated evidence made necessary by the above, local Chrome and Firefox builds for the owner's review, and an accurate description of pull request 9.
outOfScope: The content script, its stylesheet, the background component, the manifest and the fonts: what runs in a conversation does not change.
How direction, font, size and spacing are applied; how a bookmark is saved, found, returned to or stored, and its limit of 1000; the commands and how keys are assigned.
A setting for the popup's own colours, an icon in the popup, a change to the extension's icon, a new permission, a new supported site, code workspaces.
A new state or result from the page or from storage: the popup says what it is told today, in other words and in another place.
A repeat of the hour-long memory comparison, unless a change here affects what it measured.
The owner's browser profile, a signed-in site and real conversation content.
Merging pull request 9, marking it ready, a tag, a release, a store submission, store images and copy (ENT-243, paused), any write to Personal OS.
Capabilities, Exceptions, the dev-standards pin and the repository ruleset.

risk.note: The popup is how every setting is reached. The risks are a control that can no longer be operated or read, a message that claims what did not happen, and a palette with too little contrast. Each is checked in both browsers: radio and switch semantics and keyboard order, the contrast of every text in each palette, and the wording against what the page and storage report.
